THE DEFECT, reproduced 2026-08-18T06:35Z rather than inferred: while ollama is bringing a model up it answers a NON-STREAMING /api/chat with a NON-FINAL frame — HTTP 200, 96 bytes, {"model":"","created_at":"0001-01-01T00:00:00Z","message":{"role":"","content":""},"done":false}. Unload the model (keep_alive 0, ps empty) and four identical requests return it at 14.2s, 0.1s, 0.1s, 0.1s; once the model is up, six consecutive successes at 0.2-8.9s across num_ctx 8192/32768/81920. host.py's chat branch PASSES that frame — its shape check asks only that message be a dict with a str content, and "" is one — and metered_cost then refuses talking about missing counters. The counters are missing because nothing was evaluated; nothing was evaluated because the answer was never final. ONE PREDICATE FIXES IT: a non-streaming response with done:false is the host saying 'not yet', and it belongs refused by that name before the meter is ever asked — generate and embed want the same look. This is not cosmetic for the apprentice: every drive that starts against a cold hex dies with an error naming the wrong organ. SECOND TICKET STILL OWED: the second test run's wall clock is unmeasured (the driver now runs the test twice on a drive that reaches an edit — aider's inside the loop is the apprentice's feedback, the parent's is the record's authority). Then back to the standing intention: the apprentice still has 0 surviving edits on real ticket work, and max_reflections stays 0 by default — this voyage made the feedback REACHABLE, not automatic, and raising the default is a bounds question for Akien.
